correctness.rationale: Exact finite theorem established by two exhaustive, logically distinct search spaces and an explicit edge-preserving and edge-reflecting bijection. Enumerating perfect matchings by least exposed vertex gives 60 without omitting any matching; 36 have complement (10,10) and 24 (20). Splitting every complement cycle gives (36*2+24)/3=32 unlabeled factorizations. Each of the three color pairs and all its connected cycles are switched, yielding exactly 36 undirected edges and component orders [20,2,2,2,2,2,2]. An explicit mapping witnesses isomorphism of the 20-vertex component with GP(10,3) by exact 30-edge-set equality. Independent direct coloring backtracking reconstructs the 32 states and all 36 edges without using matchings. All supplied programs executed successfully and matched packaged records. Scope is finite, exact, and no infinite generalization is inferred.

value.rationale: For a canonical distance-transitive cubic graph and natural one-factorization move, an entire connected component of the coloring reconfiguration graph is unexpectedly isomorphic to the original graph itself, while twelve more states have a distinct one-neighbor mobility profile. This determines global adjacency, components, and metric structure, addressing more than the previously tabulated number of Kempe-equivalence classes. The isomorphism is a motivated, exact, non-subsumed natural invariant and is fully reproducible.
